sources.label: Vibe
sources.author: Vibe
patch_list: Blocks the 'This app is out of date' update screen and popup on launch.
Changes the version code of 365Score to prevent forced updates.
Removes banner and interstitial advertisements from 365Score.
Removes analytics and tracking (Firebase Analytics) from 365Score.
Allows Google Sign-In and account sync to work on non-rooted devices by redirecting Google Play Services to ReVanced GmsCore / MicroG.
Unlocks 365Score premium/pro features (ad-free, tipster, plus, notification sounds).
